Optional: ratings already work without it. To use your own MDBList account (your lists, your quota), sign in at mdblist.com, open Preferences, copy the API key and type it here (easier from the web panel, Settings tab, by pasting it).
Optional: with a free account at opensubtitles.com the limit goes from 5 to 20 subtitles a day.
The daily subtitle limit is over. It renews in 24 h (with an OpenSubtitles account it is 20 a day).
This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

Optional: your MDBList lists (such as Top 250) become categories in Movies and Series.
1. Point the phone camera at the code on the left and sign in (or create a free account). At the end of the page, tap API Access, generate the key if there is none yet, and copy it.
2. Point at the code on the right: the web panel opens on Settings. Paste the key under MDBList and tap Save key.
3. The TV checks it right away and this screen continues by itself.
